method.allocation: Whole-file move-only seed; no extracted methods, new adapters, or future API sizes estimated.
method.filePairs: Distinct directed production source-file pairs from Ramify application accesses; includes type dependencies, excludes npm/builtins.
method.originals: Distinct resolved original identities imported outside each proposed group; not a proposed API or required exposure count.
method.tests: Distinct testing source files with direct imports into a group; helpers count, transitive test reach does not.
method.history: Latest 40 non-merge commits touching current harness-owned production files, drawn from 160 path commits; includes refactors, excludes deleted/moved-away files.
method.lines: Physical splitlines including blank lines and comments; bytes are UTF-8 file bytes.
method.identity: Batch and resident input IDs are retained separately. Every check inventory source/resource hash matches disk and every file byte count matches measure; architect, measure and affected share a resident revision.
